# polymarket-sports-mcp
> Tools and research for copying profitable Polymarket sports specialists onto Polymarket US, with every bet approved by a human. All data files below are generated by the copy pipeline (v4, rankings as of 2026-11-08; strategy and live book updated 2026-11-11). No secrets are stored here.

- [docs/STRATEGY.md](docs/STRATEGY.md): the full method. Data endpoints, global→US slug mapping (aec/asc/tsc, UTC date fix, BUY_SHORT = 1 − price), selection tiers, credibility score, **flat ~$10 stakes**, resting-order execution, fee formula, and the HomeRunHazard NBA-spread rule (copy only his biggest spread at ≥ 1.2× usual size; never mirror his full two-sided book).
- [docs/BACKTEST.md](docs/BACKTEST.md): condensed walk-forward results, plus the 2026-10-03 to 2026-11-11 HomeRunHazard NBA spread copy study (236 games; biggest-only +13.8% at his prices, full mirror loses as a taker).
- [docs/TRADE_LOG.md](docs/TRADE_LOG.md): every real pipeline bet placed so far, with price, shares, fee, wallet copied, and result. Pipeline record as of 2026-11-11 10:35 PM PT: **15-9, net +$32.48** on $155.52, with three Nov 12 resting orders still pending (Giants ML, G2 +1.5, Wizards +11.5).
- [data/rankings.json](data/rankings.json): every wallet × league × bet-type segment with settled bets, own ROI, shrunk credibility score, sizing-skill stats, status (keep/watch/drop), and field definitions.
- [data/specialists.json](data/specialists.json): wallets currently copied (keep/watch tiers) and their allowed segments.
- [data/suppressed.json](data/suppressed.json): wallets profiled and not copied, with the reason. Rechecked after 30 days.
